name: free-sign-verifier
description: Client-side verifier library for FreeSign-signed PDFs — the exact code that runs at free-sign.com/verify.
//dependencies: verify.js loads @noble/post-quantum lazily — ONLY when a PDF carries the ML-DSA post-quantum co-signature. Every other check (CMS, chain, RFC 3161, OpenTimestamps, evidence) runs on Node built-ins alone, so `npm install` is optional unless you verify post-quantum-sealed PDFs.
